{{Quote|Incompetent workforce. I ran Graag the Hutt's spice warehousing on Kessel, and it was no better then.|Administrator Kroius|<ref name="The Mind Trap">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Mind Trap|Quesh}}</ref>}}
'''Graag''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] leader of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Quesh war|Quesh crisis]] in [[3642 BBY]], the Hutt Cartel had sent Graag to [[Quesh]] to oversee the destruction of the [[Three Families]] and the Cartel's neutrality in the war. However, Graag and his Cartel droids were unable to make progress against the Three Families, due to their factories being defended by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Adrenal Shutdown" />
